source: User phase-dependent objective request in this chat

profiles.focus: 优先发展阳光生产能力

priority_semantics: Context-dependent ordered preferences; no fixed percentage weights or scripted build order.

emergency_override.trigger: Visible evidence of imminent breach or urgent threat requiring response.
emergency_override.resume_behavior: Reassess the stage priorities when threat decreases; do not blindly replay canceled actions.

uncertain_phase.label: 阶段待确认
uncertain_phase.behavior: Refresh observations, address explicit risks, avoid speculative high-cost action.

integration_days.9: Pass phase priorities to LLM and record chosen goal
integration_days.10-12: Validate goal relevance on fresh observations and log results
integration_days.16: Evaluate stage priorities, emergency overrides, low-threat aesthetic choices and justified asymmetry.
integration_days.17-20: Render goals and goal-change events in sidebar and timeline

formation_aesthetics.preference: 尽量对称、整齐、美观，允许合理不对称
formation_aesthetics.activation: Threat is observed to be low, resources allow, and stage goals and necessary defenses remain satisfied.
formation_aesthetics.default_symmetry_reference: Upper/lower balance across the horizontal centerline; coordinate mapping pending day03 calibration.
layout_preferences: 同类植物尽量成列对齐
上下对应位置相互呼应
经济、输出和阻挡分区清楚
formation_aesthetics.emergency_behavior: Immediately permit asymmetric defense when tactically needed; reconsider appearance after stabilization.
formation_aesthetics.restoration: Improve symmetry through useful normal construction or replacement after losses, only when appropriate.
must_not: Remove effective plants solely for symmetry
Exhaust emergency reserve for matching decoration
